newsitem.title: EGYPT: Medinet makes 70 mln pound profit from Heliopolis.
newsitem.headline: Medinet makes 70 mln pound profit from Heliopolis.

text.p: Medinet Nasr Housing and Development made a profit of 70 million pounds ($20.6 million) when it sold its stake in Heliopolis Housing and Development, Medinet Nasr chairman Taher el-Maghrebi said.

In an announcement in the government newspaper al-Akhbar on Friday, Maghrebi said Medinet Nasr sold its 193,000 shares this week for 81 million pounds -- about 420 pounds a share. "It thus realised a profit of 70 million pounds," he added.
Both housing companies helped pull the Egyptian stock exchange all-share index up to record levels this week.
Medinet Nasr jumped 42.00 pounds on Thursday to close the week at 425.00 and Heliopolis gained 69.98 pounds to 500.00.
Medinet Nasr's stake in Heliopolis Housing was about four percent of the 4.945 million shares in the company.
